question: Who is Gaston, Duke Of Orléans's paternal grandmother?

steps.observation:
[Search] Results for '(Observation 14: Gaston, Duke Of Orléans)':
[Doc 1] Gaston, Duke of Orléans: Gaston, Duke of Orléans (24 April 1608 – 2 February 1660), was the third son of King Henry IV of France and his wife Marie de' Medici.

[Doc 2] Gaston, Duke of Orléans: As the eldest surviving brother of King Louis XIII, he was known at court by the traditional honorific Monsieur.

[Doc 3] Gaston, Duke of Orléans: He later acquired the title Duke of Orléans, by which he was generally known during his adulthood.

[Doc 4] Gaston, Duke of Orléans: As a son of the king, he was born a "Fils de France".

[Doc 5] Gaston of Foix, Duke of Nemours: His maternal grandparents were Charles, Duke of Orléans and Marie of Cleves.
